title: A Comparison of Uncertainty in AI and Dynamical Climate Ensembles
abstract: arXiv:2611.31064v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Climate model ensembles and their uncertainty estimates are essential for evaluating risk and designing climate policy. Yet, in the assessment of newly developed AI climate models, evaluating uncertainty is often secondary to diagnosing mean-state climate biases and trends. In this work, we conduct the first systematic comparison of uncertainty representation in ensembles of state-of-the-art AI and dynamical atmospheric climate models. Examining 2-meter temperature, 500 hPa geopotential height, and precipitable water, we find that the AI ensemble exhibits reduced internal variability and model uncertainty across variables relative to the dynamical ensemble. We show that this dampened variability causes the AI ensemble to produce more limited climate extremes and yields underdispersion relative to ERA5. Under a uniform warming scenario, the AI ensemble shows increased model uncertainty. Dynamical models grapple with their own challenges

translated_title: AI气候模式集合与动力学气候模式集合中不确定性的比较
translated_abstract: 气候模式集合及其不确定性估计对于风险评估和气候政策设计至关重要。然而，在评估新开发的AI气候模式时，不确定性评估往往让位于对平均态气候偏差和趋势的诊断。在这项工作中，我们首次对最先进的AI大气气候模式与动力学大气气候模式集合中的不确定性表征进行了系统比较。通过检验2米温度、500 hPa位势高度和可降水量，我们发现相对于动力学集合，AI集合在各个变量上表现出更弱的内部变率和模式不确定性。我们证明，这种被抑制的变率导致AI集合产生更为有限的气候极端事件，并且相对于ERA5表现出离散度不足。在均匀增暖情景下，AI集合显示出模式不确定性的增加。而动力学模式也面临着它们自身的挑战。
tldr: 本研究首次系统比较了最先进的AI与动力学大气气候模式集合的不确定性表征，发现AI集合的内部变率和模式不确定性更低，导致气候极端事件范围更窄且相对ERA5离散度不足，而在均匀增暖情景下其模式不确定性反而增加。
